verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a SaaS payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Stripe Connect's source is published under an open license. The pack covers only the hosted API, embedded components, the Dashboard, a CLI, an MCP server and llms.txt, none of which is open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
